## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T674 in two fascicles is [地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85)'s Táng retranslation of the same Indic *Mahāyāna-abhisamaya* underlying [T673](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0330) of [闍那耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D). The alternate title *Rù yīqiē fójìng zhì pílúzhēnàzàng jīng* 入一切佛境智陪盧遮那藏經 ("Sūtra of Vairocana-storehouse on the Entry into the Wisdom of All-Buddha-Realm") preserved in the source colophon parallels the alternate title of T673 — confirming that the two are translations of a single Indic original.

**Abstract**

The translation is unanimously ascribed to [地婆訶羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%B0%E5%A9%86%E8%A8%B6%E7%BE%85) (Divākara, 614–688). Date bracket follows his Cháng'ān productive period (Yífèng 儀鳳 era, 676 onward, until his death in 688). T674 is a slightly more polished and idiomatic Tang rendering of the *Mahāyāna-abhisamaya* programme that [T673](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0330) had already given Chinese readers in the Northern Zhōu. The two together (and the lost Indic original) constitute one of the lesser but doctrinally coherent strands of the East Asian *tathāgatagarbha* literature.

Related canonical texts: [KR6i0330](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0330) (大乘同性經 / T673), the parallel earlier translation by [闍那耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D).
